en.title: Count Words with a Letter Repeated Three Times
en.description:
Given a sentence containing only English letters and spaces, count the words in which at least one letter (ignoring case) appears three or more times. Each word counts only once.

The input protocol and the examples in this batch were compiled by CSWork.
en.input: One line of 1..100000 ASCII characters, containing only English words and spaces, with no leading or trailing spaces and no punctuation.
en.output: Output the number of qualifying words.
en.explanation: Process according to the definite rules above; see the accompanying editorial for the approach, proof of correctness, and complexity.
hints: For each word, count letter frequencies ignoring case. If some letter has frequency at least 3, the word counts as one.
